verdicts.reason: A inverts the hierarchy: 'JOIN OUR CHOIR!' is tiny, smaller than 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!'. The white cloud graphic floats on its own as a faint blob with no purpose, and the thumbnail photo leaves a dead left margin. B keeps the headline as the dominant element, but it sits at the far right after the subtitle, so it reads backwards. It also wraps awkwardly onto two lines, and the cloud and sparkle decoration is crushed into a stray strip of fragments under the photo. B is the less bad of the two.
